scope: Functional McKernel OS/apps and Rust/assembly migration only; no security testing.

new_FFI.name: bfd_close_all_done
new_FFI.Rust: unsafe extern C fn(*mut Bfd) -> bool

normal_terminal_call.name: bfd_close
normal_terminal_call.count: Exactly once on completed conversion, before success ACK
normal_terminal_call.FALSE_semantics: Handle consumed and owner disarmed; preserve bfd_close primary diagnostic, never retry or use handle

early_error_terminal_call.name: bfd_close_all_done
early_error_terminal_call.count: Exactly once only if handle is still owned
early_error_terminal_call.semantics: No pending-output finalization; preserve primary error diagnostic first; handle is unconditionally destroyed including FALSE, never retried
early_error_terminal_call.limitation: Selected target cleanup FALSE may skip underlying iovec bclose; real OS descriptor/file behavior is not proven by mock handle consumption

names.lifetime: All caller-owned physical section-name blocks remain live through every BFD use and terminal close/abort, then free exactly once
names.allocation: Private40B block:8B next link +32B existing name; no public dump layout change

bitmap: OwnedAllocation immediately owns each successful bitmap allocation and releases on all helper returns
SDK_prerequisite: PINNED-ABI /usr/lib64/libbfd.so is a382-byte GNU ld linker script, not ELF. It selects /usr/lib64/libbfd.a plus libsframe.a/liberty/z/dl. Header and script match official sameNEVRA exactly, but selected SDK libbfd.a bytes are not recorded by PINNED-ABI and have NOT been compared to extracted official static archive. Therefore selected actual linked implementation proof remains OPEN; this is source/package evidence and does not assert actual SDK/provider identity or native acceptance.
